translations.web: The islands have seen, and fear. The ends of the earth tremble. They approach, and come.
translations.bsb: The islands see and fear; the ends of the earth tremble. They approach and come forward.
translations.kjv: The isles saw it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.
translations.asv: The isles have seen, and fear; the ends of the earth tremble; they draw near, and come.
